steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen, whose default stage is Auction.
Apply a pricing template so line items and the pricing sheet are available.
Add the product needed for automatic title generation.
Set a delivery location, the second input required for the automatic title.
Confirm the delivery location was selected in the line-item sheet.
